responsibility: Implements the Armv8-A cryptographic machine-description patterns for the 32-bit Arm backend. It defines RTL expands and insns for AES, SHA, and PMULL operations, includes special expansion logic for AES erratum mitigation and fused AESE/AESMC or AESD/AESIMC sequences, handles endian-sensitive lane selection for SHA forms, and maps crypto builtins and vector operations onto the corresponding target instructions and instruction types.
same_name_distinction: Contains the RTL machine-description expands and insn patterns that generate Arm crypto instructions and erratum-mitigation sequences, whereas crypto.def is only the macro list of crypto builtins and their mode metadata.
